steps.label: Rank by similarity
steps.sub: Cosine to the profile, skip seen

code:
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    stop_words="english")
X_items = tfidf.fit_transform(descriptions)
profiles = clicks @ X_items.toarray()
scores = cosine_similarity(profiles,
                           X_items)
scores = np.where(clicks == 1,
                  -np.inf, scores)

new = tfidf.transform(
    ["ergonomic vertical mouse"
     " with adjustable dpi"])
for u in (0, 40):
    s = cosine_similarity(
        profiles[[u]], new)[0, 0]
    print("new item, user", u,
          round(s, 2))
